name: What should I do to prepare my home for a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your kitchen renovation begins, it's advisable to clear out all cabinets and drawers, removing food, dishes, and small appliances. Set up a temporary kitchen in another area of your home if possible, with a microwave, refrigerator, and sink access. Protect adjacent rooms and furniture from dust by covering them with plastic sheeting and closing off doorways. Discuss with your contractor about utility shut-offs and access points to ensure a smooth start to the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing out the kitchen, setting up a temporary cooking area, protecting adjacent rooms from dust, and discussing utility access with your contractor.
